title: How chlorine destroys ozone
caption: UV light breaks C–Cl bonds in CFCs high in the stratosphere, releasing chlorine radicals. Each Cl• destroys an ozone molecule and is regenerated, so one radical can destroy many thousands of O₃ molecules before it is removed.
alt: A cycle: Cl• reacts with O₃ to give ClO• and O₂; ClO• reacts with an O atom to give O₂ and Cl• again.
description: Overall: O₃ + O → 2O₂; chlorine is regenerated.
